posts.title: Avoiding the AIceberg - How blindly trusting tech hurts us all
posts.description: Notes of my talk at the German Science Society about the current state of AI and our approach to it. It is a lot like the blind belief in technology that cost a lot of people their lives when the Titanic sank.

posts.title: Pardon my dust 2 – redesigning christianheilmann.com
posts.description: Shifting my blog away from Godaddy and Wordpress has become a full-on redesign of the site. You can check it out now and I explain some of the CSS magic I added.

posts.title: Without-love – a creative coding challenge
posts.description: Calling out an creative coding challenge to win tickets for WeAreDevelopers events. Can you turn Lao Tzu quotes into something cool? And yes, we gave the tasks to AI agents, too.
